name: AdaptiveAvgPool3d

y.description: Pooled tensor, shape determined by output_size

description: Applies 3D adaptive average pooling over an input signal composed of several input planes. The output is of size D x H x W, for any input size. Supports 4D (N,C,D_in,H_in,W_in) and 3D (C,D,H,W) input with output_size as a tuple (D,H,W) or single int D for D x D x D. None means same size as input.
